OTP_Q1: Target partially achieved. Reason for deviation noted.
ReasonforDeviation_Q2:
Due to the national budget cuts, the  Department of Cooperative Governance (DCOG) reduced the participant target for the Western Cape from 17 500  to 13 725.

The Western Cape currently exceeds the new target by 1363 participants. This implies that the Western Cape will have to exit participants over time to meet the target.
OTP_Q2: The PDO notes the target is partially achieved  and the reason for deviation.
ReasonforDeviation_Q3: The  Department of Cooperative Governance (DCOG) reduced the participant target for the Western Cape from 17 500  to 13 725, however the Microsoft Information System (MIS) report. indicates a higher target of  15 450.
OTP_Q3: The PDO notes the target has been partially achieved and the reason for deviation.
ReasonforDeviation_Q4: Budget cuts prevented the Provincial, District, and site managers from effectively monitoring and overseeing CWP sites. On the CWP, sites were not permitted to recruit new participants.
OTP_Q4: The PDO notes the reason for deviation for the under performance.
ReasonforDeviation_Summary: Given that the CWP provides a safety net of 2 days per week, 8 days per month, participants exit the programme when there are seasonal work opportunities on farms.
OTP_Summary: The PDO notes the Annual Target was partially achieved and the reason for deviation as well as the slight decrease in the MTEF period within the 2025-26 APP.
